target.title: fix(web-fetch): extract full HTML body content
target.body:
Closes #82685.

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users and agents running `web_fetch` on an HTML page could receive only the page title instead of visible body content when Readability returned non-empty title-only output.

The linked issue did not include the original URL or a full HTML fixture, so this update keeps the problem statement tied to the reported invariant: title/header-only extraction must not be treated as a successful body extraction.

## Why This Change Was Made

The runtime now treats title-only Readability output as incomplete after normalizing markdown/plain text, then continues through the existing recovery order: configured provider output first, local raw HTML body cleanup last. The local body cleanup path also scans for the real document body while skipping fake `<body>` tags inside comments, raw-text containers, and inert or nested `<template>` content.

This keeps the fix scoped to the `web_fetch` runtime extraction decision. It does not change shared HTML-to-markdown helpers, provider configuration, network/auth/security policy, migrations, schema, public API shape, or the provider catalog.

## User Impact

Users and agents should now get visible page body content instead of title-only output for this class of HTML extraction failure. If a configured provider can handle the page, provider output still wins before local raw HTML cleanup, preserving the existing compatibility boundary.

No config, migration, auth, secrets, network capability, or tool execution behavior changes are required.

## Evidence

- Runtime proof: ran the real Readability extractor, then ran the real `web_fetch` tool path against a deterministic HTML fixture where Readability returns only the title. External network access was not required for this proof.

  ```text
  web_fetch title-only fallback proof
  fixture url: https://fixture.openclaw.test/title-only-aside-body
  readability.title: "Sample Page"
  readability.text: "Sample Page"
  readability.titleOnly: true
  web_fetch.status: 200
  web_fetch.contentType: text/html
  web_fetch.extractor: raw-html
  web_fetch.title.hasSamplePage: true
  web_fetch.text.hasBodyMarker: true
  ```

- Focused validation: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/tools/web-tools.fetch.test.ts` passed with 1 test file and 37 tests passing.
- Regression coverage includes title-only Readability text, markdown heading title-only output, fake body tags inside comments/raw-text/template/declaration regions, nested inert templates, and the provider-before-raw fallback order.
- Proof limitation: the exact reporter page was not available from the issue, so the runtime proof uses a deterministic representative fixture that reproduces the title-only/body-cleanup invariant.
- Current state: ready for maintainer review after the updated branch is submitted and CI reruns on the PR.
